description: Energie uit oppervlaktewater (EOW) | Warmte - Gemalen en Stuwen (Dataset) is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Kunstwerken Gemalen (en andere kunstwerken) kunnen voorzien worden van warmtewisselaars waarmee warmte gewonnen kan worden uit de waterstroom. Hiermee kan met een kleine investering een zeer hoog warmte vermogen worden opgewekt. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are bodem, energie, water. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2024-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
